The United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement continues to underpin robust North American trade and investment that has benefited millions. With the July 1 review deadline approaching, the agreement’s future is once again up for debate.

Join Cato on June 25 for a policy forum on what's at stake, featuring a fireside chat with House Ways & Means Trade Subcommittee Chair @RepAdrianSmith (R-NE) and Cato's @scottlincicome, followed by a panel of regional experts.

Affordability is one of the defining challenges facing American households. Yet many of the solutions proposed in Washington focus on treating the symptoms rather than addressing the causes of rising costs.

Cato's @cpgrabow and @JaiKedia discussed the new Cato Institute Handbook on Affordability at a Capitol Hill briefing, making the case that lasting affordability comes from greater economic freedom, not more government intervention.

Check it out: ow.ly/Ypq050ZenBR
